## Summary

Higher Vocational Degree in Web Application Development (DAW, Jun 2026). Capstone MyPlaythrough awarded top honors. Builds APIs and databases first — FastAPI, Node/Express, PostgreSQL, Redis — and ships React frontends when the product needs them.

## Selected projects

- [ReckonFlow](https://reckon-flow.onrender.com/docs) — corporate travel reconciliation API (Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis)
- MyPlaythrough — personal game library manager, DAW capstone (React, Node, PostgreSQL)
- Live Event Radar — real-time venue ops dashboard (Next.js, React, TypeScript)
- Aiba — local-first Windows productivity companion (Electron)
